summary: Phase 3 HA Transactions tested end-to-end. 37/38 backend tests pass (97.4%). Quotation Studio (create/get with margin analysis, status machine, pair rule, role gate), Sales (quote→sale conversion with serial reserve, margin gate with all 3 branches of no-approval 409 / frontdesk-approver 403 / super-admin 200, serial validations, mark-paid idempotent, cancel-unreserve, converted_sale_no audit preserved), relativedelta warranty and PO state machine all work. Frontend Quotations tab, detail drawer, role hiding for audiologist all verified. ONE real backend bug found: duplicate-serial GRN returns 500 instead of 409 because insert_many raises BulkWriteError, not DuplicateKeyError.

critical.issue: Returns 500 instead of 409 when a serial_no collides with an existing row. ha_procurement.py:353 catches DuplicateKeyError but motor's insert_many raises pymongo.errors.BulkWriteError (code 11000 inside writeErrors). The except block misses it, so it propagates as 500.

ui_bugs.issue: Typing 'raja' in ha-quote-patient-search yields 0 dropdown options even though the clinic has many Raja Gopal patients. Likely debounce/search-param mismatch between modal and /api/patients query API.

action_items: Fix ha_procurement.create_grn: catch pymongo.errors.BulkWriteError (or inspect e.details['writeErrors'][0]['code']==11000) in addition to DuplicateKeyError — currently surfaces as HTTP 500 instead of the intended 409 with serial_no in the message.

Investigate NewQuoteModal patient search: dropdown returns 0 hits even though the /api/patients endpoint clearly has matching records (existing quotations show 'Raja Gopal'). Likely wrong query param name or missing debounce-trigger.
critical_code_review_comments: ha_sales.create_sale_from_quote allows converting from 'draft' or 'sent' quotations (not only 'accepted'). This is noted as a walk-in convenience in the docstring, but it means the explicit accept → convert flow can be bypassed. Consider surfacing this as a separate flag rather than silent permissiveness.

ha_sales.cancel_sale does NOT revert quote.status back from 'converted' — explicitly documented and intentional for audit, but make sure UI surfaces 'sale cancelled' on the quote so users don't think the quote is still active.
ha_quotations._validate_pair requires qty == 1 on each side; multi-pair bundles (e.g. 2 L + 2 R) would fail. Not a bug today but worth a comment.
BulkWriteError handling missing in ha_procurement.create_grn (root cause of the 500 above).

Frontend QuotationStudioPage drawer overlay (class flex-1 bg-black/40) intercepts pointer events outside it — backdrop click-to-close works, but programmatic nav-sidebar clicks while drawer open get blocked. Minor UX.

Patient search bug is frontend-only and verifiable in /ha/quotations → +New Quote modal.
rca of the issue: ha_procurement.py line 352 uses db.serial_items.insert_many([...]) which, on motor/pymongo, surfaces write errors as pymongo.errors.BulkWriteError (a subclass of OperationFailure). The subsequent `except DuplicateKeyError` does NOT catch BulkWriteError — they are siblings, not a chain. Fix: `except (DuplicateKeyError, BulkWriteError) as e:` and pull offending serial via `e.details['writeErrors'][0]['keyValue']['serial_no']`. Reproduce: GRN a serial once, attempt a second GRN with the same serial_no → current code returns 500, expected 409 per Phase 3 contract.
